    // One of a cell's two diagonals: `diagonal` 0 runs from (column, row) to
    // (column + 1, row + 1), and 1 runs the other way.
    GridShearSpring(self: ClothGrid3D, column: Integer, row: Integer, diagonal: Integer, compliance: Number): ClothDistanceConstraint
        => diagonal == 0
            ? self.GridSpring(column, row, column + 1, row + 1, compliance)
            : self.GridSpring(column + 1, row, column, row + 1, compliance);
